title: Retribution
paragraphs: “The representative of Shieldfreeden really stole the show, didn’t he?”
“He certainly had the bearing of a champion. Though his methods were pure evil…”
“I felt that we must once again acknowledge the fact that Lord Gaelion—who is lending us his strength—is a being unlike any human…”
“Can’t you acknowledge a serious knight?”

“To be honest, yes. But… our opponent was even more evil than that. Out of consideration for Lord Kitamura’s feelings, I’ll pretend I didn’t see it. Those who lead others must sometimes possess this level of wickedness… I suppose. That’s what I’ve learned.”
That’s what the pandas are saying, you know.
“Come on, Spear Hero. Do your usual thing.”
“That’s right. Come to think of it… I haven’t done that with Takt yet.”
If I’d known, I wouldn’t have bragged about it, and I’d have said there was a countermeasure. So, I’ll make this Takt scream in humiliation, too.
“The Love Hunter commands. Holy Weapon. Vassal Weapons. Answer the call of the Love Hunter, break free from the bonds of foolish power, and awaken!”
The sword dwelling within Takt’s hand glows brightly. I’ve seen this before, haven’t I?
And Rival… I targeted your claws as well, but there’s no reaction!
“W-what!? What’s going on!? Guh… My strength is draining away! W-what did you do?!”
The Seven Star Weapons break free from Takt’s hand and float around us. The Sacred Sword soared high into the sky, flying right through the wall.

Oh… Just as Trash said, Ren is alive. I did think that if Takt had shown up from the start, I should’ve done this, but I didn’t have the guts to accept the destruction of Filolial-sama’s egg… so in the end, I probably wouldn’t have been able to do it anyway.
“Huh? Eek!?”
Just then, one of the weapons Takt was holding flew toward Zou! In Zou’s hand… was a Seven Star Weapon designed for throwing.
“This is… hmm…”

In a flash, Zou transformed the Seven Star Weapons into an iron ball and bounced it upward as lightly as a regular ball. Judging from how he’d been throwing rocks and such… he’s certainly skilled enough as a user.
“Whoa… Elmelo, that’s amazing! Throw it, throw it!”
“Got it.”
With a flick of his wrist, Zou complied with Kou’s request and tossed the iron ball, sending it flying with a whoosh. Kou ran off to chase after it.
“The Seven Star Weapons are being treated like toys…”
“Elmelo, for the sake of dignity, you should keep that kind of play to a minimum here.”
“You’re right… Shield Hero, my apologies.”
Leaving that idyllic scene behind, Father fixed his gaze on Takt.

“Seriously… Your strategy was certainly effective. It was a real struggle for us to deal with it… If you hadn’t shown up, we might still have survived… You’re such an idiot. I feel deeply sorry for you.”
Father addresses Takt with such kind words.
“Aaaaaaaaaaaah! You’re sooooooo annoyingyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy! You guys are all so shallow, aaaaaaaaaah!”
“So whenever something doesn’t go your way, you call the other person shallow, is that it?”
“You cocky shield-wielding jerk! When it comes to villains, you can do whatever you want! We all band together to bring down evil. That’s just how the world works, isn’t it!”
“Ah, that’s right. We all take down evil together. That’s why you’re going to be judged.”

“That’s not right! I’m going to make this a peaceful world, so I’m going to wipe every single one of you show-off losers off the face of the earth! I’ll wipe out every last one of you! All you show-offs like you guys!　If you guys hadn’t even come to this world in the first place, I could’ve made the world peaceful! If only you weren’t here!! I could’ve lived my life happily!! If only you guys weren’t here…!!!”
That’s quite the long rant. My nausea has reached its limit.

“I really can’t see it that way… Because, seeing how the people of Shieldfreeden lived, I don’t think you were making them happy. Because of what you took from them… everyone was miserable. In a sense, it’s equality, but you’ve misunderstood the meaning of freedom. It’s all because of you and Nelshen. You’ve trampled on others way too much for your own happiness.”

“I’ve got plenty of friends! You guys, who can do such terrible things without a second thought, must’ve been bullied in your original world, too. I cherish this world. I love it! You guys need to respect me more! I said respect me! You arrogant bastard!”
Takt is acting like a child, yelling and ranting without listening to Father! Father lets out a deep sigh at Takt’s response.
“Motoyasu-kun, don’t you think it’s time to put him out of his misery?”
“Father, I’m sorry, but that’s not an option…”
I just can’t stand it anymore. Not only did this guy turn the Filolial-sama into that state, but he’s also the one who raided the Filolial producers’ ranch.

“As originally planned, I won’t be able to stand it unless I make him suffer horribly first before he gets his comeuppance! That’s right—no matter which loop we go into, I’ll definitely make him suffer and then kill him!”
“Oh, well… Even if Gaelion has made him suffer this much as a token of mercy, the Spear Hero won’t let him off the hook.”
“So it really was Gaelion-chan’s way of showing kindness, after all.”

“That’s right… otherwise, Takt’s future would be just too pitiful. I thought he might forgive me after torturing him this much, but it was impossible. To be honest, the Spear Hero is so single-minded—once he decides on something, he never wavers—so I ended up feeling sorry for him. But… it seems Takt didn’t need that.”

What exactly are you feeling sorry for? As for Takt—who has shattered Filolial-sama’s eggs as many times as there are stars—we will undoubtedly make him suffer horribly, as many times as there are stars, before killing him. We won’t let him die instantly from a Brionac attack again.

“W-What are you planning to do! You’re acting all tough, but you guys are still heroes, aren’t you—albeit flawed ones! Are you even human!? If you were human, you wouldn’t do something like this! You show-off!”
“I am The Love Hunter!”
“Ah… yeah, you shouldn’t think of the Spear Hero as human. There’s no doubt about it—he’s doing things with a straight face that no human could endure.”
“Gaelion-chan, you really shouldn’t say that.”

Even though all of Takt’s weapons have been taken away and the pigs are begging for their lives and trying to surrender, he’s still showing hostility and raising his fist at us. Hahaha, how pathetic. Show us even more of that disgrace!
“I’m strong! That’s why I’m great! So obey me! You show-off! I’ll never forgive you! You’ll stay like this for the rest of your life! A loser forever! I don’t want to live!”
Takt staggered to his feet and lunged at me, but I dodged him with ease.
“Ah… don’t get your hopes up. You definitely won’t make it out alive.”
“First, I’ll shut that pointlessly noisy mouth of yours and take you alive! I’ll make your very soul suffer!　Paralyze Lance X!”

With a thud, I powerfully thrust my spear into Takt, silencing him. It seems his body is that of an enhanced homunculus, but he couldn’t resist my full-power paralyzing attack. Takt twitched a few times, then went numb and stopped moving.
“Now, all that’s left is to completely finish off the stragglers. Make sure to take good care of the Filolials, too.”
“I’ll do that even without you telling me.”
“Mel-chan, it’s finally over, isn’t it?”
Realizing that all the enemies had been defeated, Sakura-chan spoke to her Finacée.
“Well… but what about Father…?”
That Trash is sticking close to the queen, isn’t he? He even looked completely unperturbed as he was being taken away.
“Bububu!”
“Bubhee!?”

The pig, on the other hand, was thrashing about violently. Not only were Éclair and the others holding him down, but the zombie pigs controlled by Rival were also subduing him—so I used my Paralyze Lance to paralyze him and render him unable to fight. That’s how I managed to capture Takt and his group instead of Trash.

Incidentally, I soon realized that Takt had filmed and edited footage of me and Father fighting using a video crystal, then released it to various nations like Shieldfreeden and Faubrey. It seems he was aiming to restore his standing by publicly declaring me a rotten scoundrel who fights against his fellow Four Holy Heroes. We didn’t hear any of this during the operation, but apparently, in response to the broadcast from the building we’d seized, people from Shieldfreeden were voicing their protests and throwing stones at the castle.
They were saying things like:
“Thanks to our defeat in the war against Siltvelt, we’re now living peaceful and prosperous lives!”
“We won’t be fooled anymore!”
“The former president should take responsibility and burn in hell!”
“Follow the new Divine Dragon!”

Voices like these were so loud that, had we not intervened with our weapons, they would have stormed the building. It’s become a truly appalling country where even our Rival possesses such charisma. We must urgently make this country entirely devoted to Filolial-sama.
“Well… this is the kind of place it is.”
Rival snapped his fingers, and the pigs—who had turned into zombies—collapsed to the ground as if their strings had been cut.
“Well then…”
Saying that, Rival moved a short distance away from the crowd, turned toward me, and beckoned, as if to say, “Come at me anytime.”

“Come on, Spear Hero. It’s Gaelion’s turn to pay the price with his life. Kill Gaelion as many times as you like. Just keep killing him—for every Filolial who never got to be born—until you’ve vented your frustration.”
Rival’s attitude sounds a bit dismissive, doesn’t it? But he’s staring straight at me, determined to fulfill his responsibility to the very end.
“Gaelion-chan, this incident isn’t solely your responsibility—”
Father is objecting to Rival’s argument.
“Motoyasu-sama… Yuki is also at fault in this matter. If you’re going to punish anyone, please punish Yuki as well.”
“What on earth are you saying, Yuki-chan?”

“Lord Motoyasu, I… am deeply dissatisfied, but I found the dragon’s actions to be noble. Therefore, for the sake of Filolial’s pride, I took matters into my own hands. I am fully prepared to accept my punishment.”
With her chest held high, Yuki-chan says she has no regrets about destroying the Filolial-sama’s eggs herself—what kind of expression should I make in response?
“Come to think of it, that applies to us, too.”
“That’s true…”
“But… if we’d left things as they were, it wouldn’t have ended well. I don’t think I was wrong either.”

Even Éclair and the others, including Panda, share that opinion. Ugh… During this battle with Takt—including that Trash—I was held hostage by Filolial-sama’s eggs and couldn’t do a thing. It’s an undeniable fact that things worked out for the best only because Rival boldly declared he’d take responsibility. And it seems he truly intends to shoulder that responsibility.
“Motoyasu-kun… sure, those Filolial eggs might have been more important to you than your own life. But still…”
“Father, you don’t need to say any more.”
I’ll calm down Father, who’s looking at me with a troubled expression, clearly trying to persuade me somehow. I get it. I really do.
“Rival, this is a one-time thing. Just this once, I’ll… put up with your reckless actions.”
It’s a hard fact to deny that if I hadn’t, I would’ve been completely taken advantage of by Takt. After all, I could sense that there was no mistake in Rival’s argument.
If—if Father and I had truly been defeated, Takt would have wiped out Filolial-sama. Takt said so himself, after all.
“It’s all Takt’s fault. I’ll let it be that! But don’t you ever forget the sins you’ve committed!”

Filolial-sama is also a monster, and he spoke of her as their king… Even if it was a lie, Rival acted for the sake of the remaining Filolial-sama—he protected her. Even if the great Filolial-sama still existed and Takt had been unable to eradicate him, there’s no doubt that Rival’s actions stemmed from his concern for Filolial-sama.
Since Rival—a dragon—showed such resolve in the face of Filolial-sama, I must adopt a fitting attitude as well. Otherwise, I won’t be able to face Yuki-chan or the others.
“Father, is this all right?”
“Motoyasu… Yeah. I think that’s for the best. Takt’s methods were just too cruel.”

This grudge should be directed at Takt, our true enemy! If we let that bastard Takt slip away carelessly, he’ll pull stunts like this. From now on, I’ll make you suffer horribly before I kill you, Takt! That’s what I resolved in my heart.
“So, Yuki-chan, you don’t need to worry about it. You did a great job… taking care of what I should have done myself. I’m sorry I had to put you through such a difficult ordeal.”
“Motoyasu-sama!”
Yuki-chan’s expression lit up with joy at my words, and she threw her arms around me. I gently held her close, sharing her sorrow. After spending a little while like that, I set her down.
“Gaelion-chan’s Magic… that was incredible, wasn’t it?”
“Right! I’m going to teach Naofumi, too!”
“Well… I’d rather you spare me that one, actually.”

“Naofumi probably wouldn’t have any offensive capabilities, but since he’s a hero, he’d be useful in some way… right? It looks like it might need a little tweaking. It seems like it’d work with that weapon over there, but this hero’s weapon has so many annoying restrictions—”
It seems Rival is muttering to herself as she runs some calculations. It looks like she can’t adjust it right away. Just then, Rival gives me a look that says she’s underestimating me.
“Spear Hero. I could teach you, too.”
“I don’t need it!”
“Don’t you want to weave magic by gathering the power of the Filolials? Don’t you?”
Ugh… He’s tempting me with such sweet words!
“You Demon King! I say!”
“Is that so? I’ll be waiting for you anytime!”

“Anyway, right now our top priority is protecting the Filolial-samas who’ve been affected by Takt, even if only slightly! I’ve heard reports that Filolial-samas are still running amok in various places! Yuki-chan! Make sure you see this through!”
“Yes, ma’am! Well then, let’s go! Kou, Sakura!”
“Got it!”
“I’ll head out after I drop off Mel-chan and the others.”

And so, putting Rival’s transgressions aside, we set out to quell the ensuing chaos. Of course, dealing with the remnants of Takt went smoothly. We were also able to fully liberate Shieldfreeden Castle.

Thanks to Trash’s testimony, we were able to capture the remaining Takt members who had been in hiding. I hear we’ve recovered most of the missing assets as well. Apparently, they were being transported by submarines and the like. There was even a scene where Rival and I dove in like sharks to capture them.
